name: atuin
description: Atuin replaces your existing shell history with a SQLite database, and records additional context for your commands. Additionally, it provides optional and fully encrypted synchronisation of your history between machines, via an Atuin server.
requires:
The image for this container does not have a `latest` tag. You will need to modify the image tag manually to update: https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/pkgs/container/atuin/versions. 
        [br]
        This container requires a separate Postgres database.

variables.name: Database Connection
variables.description: Connection string to the database. This is automatically set by the container.

variables.name: Internal Host
variables.description: Internal host for the Atuin server. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Log
variables.description: Log level for the Atuin server. Not recommended to change.
